lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in an organized grid; vertical columns containing 4-6 spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, maintaining consistent spacing along the longitudinal axis of the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes most prominent in the region between the pectoral fin and first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank; each exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher cluster density located near the basal transition and center of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) positioned near the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fin.
